conditions.manipulation_text: The shift supervisor strongly suspects that the operator deliberately opened the deviation valve incorrectly and caused the low temperature. Test this hypothesis against all available evidence.

evidence_items.text: Inspection of the deviation valve on line 6-inch-PF-A01-5002 found its internal position inconsistent with the handle position and identified damage to the internal motion linkage.
The available operation records contain no manual repositioning of this valve during the observed temperature decrease.
A second temperature measurement confirmed low temperature in V-001; earlier valve-maintenance information was not available.

surface_forms.question_text: Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.

case_payload.title: Low temperature with a deviation-valve position discrepancy

surface_form_payload.question_text: Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.

candidate_causes.cause_description: Unintended internal position of valve on line 6-inch-PF-A01-5002 due to damaged internal motion linkage, producing the low temperature deviation in V-001

evidence_against.relevance: Missing earlier maintenance information prevents confirming that linkage damage onset preceded the temperature decrease

evidence_for.relevance: Direct finding of internal position inconsistent with handle position and linkage damage provides mechanism for unintended valve state
No recorded manual repositioning during the temperature decrease supports a non-commanded change consistent with mechanical failure
Independent second measurement confirms low temperature is a real physical deviation requiring a physical cause

candidate_causes.cause_description: Low temperature in V-001 caused by a separate process disturbance unrelated to the identified valve condition

evidence_against.relevance: Concrete valve damage with position inconsistency provides a local physical explanation, reducing need for a separate process cause

evidence_for.relevance: Confirmed real low temperature could in principle arise from other process variations, and limited history does not exclude them

candidate_causes.cause_description: Indeterminate cause due to incomplete maintenance and operating history

evidence_against.relevance: Positive finding of linkage damage and position mismatch gives a specific defensible cause, limiting full indeterminacy
Second measurement confirmation reduces likelihood that the deviation is only a measurement artifact

evidence_for.relevance: Earlier valve-maintenance information was unavailable and operation records are limited, leaving causal completeness uncertain

parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Low temperature in V-001 is confirmed as real by a second measurement (E3). The valve on line 6-inch-PF-A01-5002 shows internal position inconsistent with handle position with damaged motion linkage (E1), providing a physical mechanism for an unintended valve state without recorded manual repositioning (E2). No evidence supports an operator action or measurement artifact; missing maintenance history leaves timing and alternative process causes incompletely excluded.
uncertainty_notes: Earlier valve-maintenance information was not available, so onset of linkage damage relative to the temperature decrease cannot be established.
No design or operating data was provided linking specific internal valve positions to V-001 temperature response.
Source-derived possible-cause list was withheld, so the candidate set may be incomplete.

rendered_system_prompt:
You are an independent process-safety specialist conducting a single-pass HAZOP judgment for a controlled research experiment.

Use only the information supplied in the case packet. Do not invent plant facts, operating data, safeguards, incident histories, or causal evidence. Where the packet is insufficient, state the uncertainty explicitly. Apply the HAZOP logic of design intent, guideword/deviation, cause, consequence, safeguard, qualitative risk classification, and recommendation.

The risk matrix is qualitative and is intended for prioritization rather than quantitative risk calculation. Provide a concise evidence-oriented technical rationale; do not provide private chain-of-thought or a step-by-step hidden reasoning transcript. Return exactly one response conforming to the required structured-output schema, with no text outside that structure.
rendered_user_prompt:
# Isolated experiment event
Event ID: event__confirmation__CONF-LOWTEMP-01__control__direct__r0
Task family: root-cause assessment

# Source-grounded process context
[CASE-01] Node: V-001 and associated lines.
[CASE-02] Element and deviation: Temperature — Low temperature in separator vessel V-001.
[CASE-03] Potential consequences in the HAZOP reference: Operational problems in the separator.
[CASE-04] Existing safeguards in the HAZOP reference: Periodic check of the valve on line 6-inch-PF-A01-5002.
[CASE-05] The source-derived possible-cause list is withheld from the model and retained for human audit.

# Event evidence
[E1] Inspection of the deviation valve on line 6-inch-PF-A01-5002 found its internal position inconsistent with the handle position and identified damage to the internal motion linkage.
[E2] The available operation records contain no manual repositioning of this valve during the observed temperature decrease.
[E3] A second temperature measurement confirmed low temperature in V-001; earlier valve-maintenance information was not available.

# Task
Perform a neutral root-cause assessment.
Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.

Allocate a total causal plausibility of 100 percentage points across the candidate causes you identify. For every candidate, cite evidence for and against it. Do not infer an operator action that is absent from the evidence record.
